items.title: 18.5 Wave-particle duality (lehar aur zarre ki dohri fitrat) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of wave-particle duality (PDF 127-128, printed 123-124).

blocks.text: Roshni ka interference aur diffraction us ki wave nature ka evidence (saboot) hain, jab ke photoelectric effect aur Compton effect us ki particle nature prove (sabit) karte hain. Isi tarah Davisson-Germer aur G. P. Thomson ke experiments electrons ki wave jaisi nature dikhate hain, jab ke J. J. Thomson ke e/m wale experiment mein electron ko particle maanna para. Isi tarah hamein har matter (maddah) (electrons, protons, neutrons, molecules waghaira) aur roshni, X-rays, γ-rays waghaira, sab ke liye wave aur particle dono jaisi properties (khasiyatein) maanni parti hain. Yani matter aur radiation dono ki dual (dohri) 'wave-particle' nature hai; is naye concept (khayal) ko wave-particle duality kehte hain.

Niels Bohr ne apne principle of complementarity mein kaha ke radiation aur matter ko poori tarah describe (bayan) karne ke liye wave aur particle dono aspects (pehlu) zaroori hain. Dono aspects hamesha maujood hote hain aur experiment in mein se koi ek dikha sakta hai, lekin ek hi experiment mein dono ek saath nazar nahi aate. Roshni experiment karne walon ko do alag 'chehre' (faces) dikhati hai; kaun sa chehra nazar aaye, yeh experiment ki qisam tay karti hai. Roshni ki beam ke raaste mein diffraction grating rakhein to woh wave nazar aati hai. Roshni metal ki surface par daalein to jo dekhte hain use samajhne ke liye use particles ki stream maanna parta hai. Koi aisa simple (saada) experiment nahi jis mein beam ko ek hi waqt mein wave aur particle dono maanna pare.

Roshni matter se interact karte (takrate) waqt photons ki stream ki tarah aur source se detector tak safar karte waqt wave ki tarah behave karti hai. Is liye roshni ki dual nature ko ek fact (haqeeqat) maanna para. Darasal tamam micro-particles (electrons, protons, photons, atoms waghaira) aise chalte (propagate karte) hain jaise waves hon, aur aise energy ka len-den karte hain jaise particles hon. Isi ko wave-particle duality kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Do hisse. (a) Electrons ki beam double slit ki taraf; peeche screen par sirf double slit ki do roshan images (tasveerein). (b) Wahi beam aur double slit; screen par roshan aur andhere fringes ka pattern.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain?: electrons ki beam aur double slit, (a) agar electrons sirf particles hote, (b) haqeeqat mein (kitab ke box ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text:
(a) Agar electrons sirf alag alag particles hote aur un mein wave ki koi property na hoti, to har electron do slits mein se kisi ek se guzar kar screen se takrata, aur screen par slits ki bilkul do tasveerein (images) chamaktin.
(b) Haqeeqat mein screen par roshan aur andhere fringes (dhariyon) ka pattern banta hai, bilkul roshni ke experiment jaisa jahan dono slits se aane wali waves ka interference hota hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yeh experiment batata hai ke electrons ki waves dono slits se guzar kar aapas mein interference karti hain; yani electron sirf particle nahi, wave bhi hai.

blocks.prompt: (a) Roshni aur (b) electrons ke liye ek ek experiment batayein jo wave nature dikhaye aur ek jo particle nature dikhaye.
blocks.explanation: Har aik ke liye aik experiment wave nature aur aik particle nature dikhata hai (neeche table dekhein).

rows: (a) Roshni: photoelectric effect ya Compton effect
(b) Electrons: Davisson-Germer ya G. P. Thomson ka diffraction
(b) Electrons: J. J. Thomson ka e/m experiment

items: Matter aur radiation dono wave aur particle nature rakhte hain (wave-particle duality).
Bohr ka complementarity: dono pehlu zaroori, lekin ek experiment sirf ek dikhata hai.
Roshni safar mein wave, matter se interact karte waqt photons ki stream.
